entities.name: Chi Chi González
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexander Rios "Chi Chi" González is an American former professional pitcher and former bullpen catcher for the Miami Marlins of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played in MLB for the Texas Rangers, Colorado Rockies, Minnesota Twins, Milwaukee Brewers, New York Yankees, and the Marlins. González goes by Chi Chi, a nickname given to him by his grandfather.
